card.name: Linking words in land and place descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "of" and "in" right after a land-area phrase such as "a portion" or "acres", or a place or region name. The setting is historical land purchases and geography.

modes.label: Land amounts
modes.description: "of" after a portion or number of acres, leading into the word land.
modes.example: purchased from the government over one thousand acres<< of>> land.

modes.label: Place location
modes.description: "in" or a similar linker after a named place, leading into a county or region.
modes.example: start in the Chequamegon-Nicolet National Forest<< in>> Forest County.

card.plain: It fires on little linking words in old land-sale and geography passages, just before a place or land term.
